description: Preserve duration-measurement isolation when an application or focused scope selects only part of the canonical Track sequence.

tasks.title: Implement scope-aware duration-measurement planning
tasks.description: Update the canonical planner to normalize configured duration-measurement Tracks to the selected lanes in configured order, then reuse the existing Resource and dependency logic. Add the deterministic partial/full/zero-match/focused regression matrix through the canonical planner and preserve existing multi-lane behavior through the narrow phase-helper unit seam without adding a production lane-expansion path.
acceptanceCriteria: A partial scope with configured measurement Tracks [cli, server-spec] and only server-spec selected retains server-spec duration-measurement isolation and does not add cli.
A full scope preserves cli before server-spec, their existing Resource claims and terminal dependencies, and the configured runner isolation boundary for remaining Vitest lanes.

A zero-match or focused scope uses an input lane with pre-existing Resources and dependsOn, preserves its serialized planner state byte-for-byte, receives no absent Track, and gains no Resource or dependency from the measurement phase.

Existing valid multi-lane coverage-terminal and malformed fail-closed behavior is covered through the narrow applyDurationMeasurementPhase unit seam; no production lane-expansion or canonical duplicate-Track path is added.
The implementation does not modify test-duration configuration, scheduler behavior, Track commands, populations, budgets, deadlines, Resource limits, worker capacity, or CI topology.
scripts/test-duration/guard.test.ts contains deterministic assertions for the required selection and multi-lane matrix, and the focused planner tests pass.
npm run test:fast and npm run verify are run after the implementation; any environment limitation or unrelated failure is recorded with the delivered result.
tasks.output: Scope-aware applyDurationMeasurementPhase implementation and passing planner regression coverage in scripts/test-duration/guard.ts and scripts/test-duration/guard.test.ts.
tasks.notes: Keep the change inside the shared planner boundary. Preserve the existing fail-closed behavior for duplicate configuration IDs and malformed multi-lane groups; do not add a new abstraction or configuration path.
